name: Vote 18 Choice
definition: Determines how the voting instructions are specified.

VoteInstruction.name: Vote Instruction
VoteInstruction.definition: Instruction specifying the instructed quantity of voting rights per resolution.

GlobalVoteInstruction.name: Global Vote Instruction
GlobalVoteInstruction.definition: Instruction specifying a vote instruction per resolution for the entire entitlement.

InFavourListingGroup1Rule.definition: If two or more occurrences of the element VoteInstruction/ListingGroupResolutionLabel have the exact same textual value, then only a single occurrence of the VoteInstruction sequence amongst these occurrences may have the element “For” (vote in favour) being present.
